meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会守着一个 PR 反复检查:轮询 CI 结果、读评论和审查线程,发现真问题就在小提交里修掉、跑测试、推送,然后回到检查,直到检查通过、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停。
howto.when: 当你要求 babysit、监控或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、审查和 CI 时接管;只要还有未解决的评论或线程,它不会只查一轮就停。

say.text: 盯着 PR 123,一直到我确认可以合并为止
say.note: 它会轮询检查并汇报进展

say.text: 监控这个 PR 的 CI 和未解决评论,有真问题就修
say.note: 它会提交、跑测试并推送修复

say.text: 看看 PR 123 还有哪些没解决的审查线程
say.note: 它会列出线程的文件和行号

howto.what_en: Claude watches a pull request: it polls CI checks, reads comments and review threads, fixes real issues in focused commits, runs tests, pushes, and repeats until checks pass and no unresolved threads remain.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR 123 until it's ready to merge.
say_en.note: It polls checks and reports back.

say_en.text: Watch this PR's CI and unresolved comments, and fix real issues.
say_en.note: It commits, tests, and pushes fixes.

say_en.text: Check PR 123 for unresolved review threads.
say_en.note: It lists open threads with file and line.
